plan.explanation: The sequence starts with face milling (F1) on M3 to establish the datum. Then outer contour (F6) is machined, followed by chamfering (F2) which requires the contour to be defined. Slot (F5) and pocket (F7) are performed using M3's milling capabilities. Threading hole (F3) involves spot drilling/drilling on M1 then tapping on M1. Reamed hole (F4) involves spot drilling/drilling on M1 then reaming on M1.
assumptions: Tool T4 is used for both spot_drilling and drilling on feature F3 and F4 as no specific drill/spot_drill tool_id exists in resources but 'drill' type matches the operation compatibility.
Tool T2 (end_mill) is assumed capable of slot_milling and pocket_milling operations.
uncertainties: Actual tool lengths and Z-axis clearance for reaming and tapping are not known.
